description: This PHP class 'RequestBodySubscriber' is a Symfony event subscriber that listens for HTTP request events. It processes requests with JSON content types, decodes the JSON payload, and adds the data to the request parameters.

classes.name: RequestBodySubscriber
classes.description: A Symfony event subscriber that listens for request events and processes JSON request bodies to add their data into request parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the events to which this subscriber subscribes, specifically the Kernel request event with a high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, decoding JSON content types and adding the decoded data to the request parameters.
